name: `shoptet doctor` command
description:
Environment sanity check: Node version, config-dir reachability, pinned-pack freshness, autoupdate status + last check. Reports which shop the project targets and whether it matches the declared development shop. Prints the fully resolved configuration with the layer each value came from (flags/env/project/machine/default) — per §5.7, this is what turns "why is dev pointing at a different shop" into one command instead of a support conversation.

--report writes a redacted support bundle (must strip shop URLs, cookies, and auth headers before the bundle leaves the machine).

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §5.7, §9.
